title: Equivalence of Euclidean AdS/CFT Generating Functionals
exact_target: Are the boundary-value and source-based Euclidean AdS/CFT generating functionals equivalent after rescaling, and does that survive removal of the cutoff?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003184 (OWR-14744-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Recent Mathematical Developments in Quantum Field Theory (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/36, pp. 2069--2122. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 15, 16.
Gottschalk--Thaler, Euclidean AdS/CFT (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Gottschalk--Thaler, triviality (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The primary report (PDF pages 15--16) explicitly says the finite-cutoff equivalence was established for $d=2$. It also reports triviality along some cutoff sequences in the massive exponential-interaction model; possible remedies such as holographic renormalization are left for future work. Thus the inherited sentence includes a known finite-cutoff comparison and an unresolved limiting/renormalization programme, rather than two newly verified open assertions.
